## What happened

This notice records reference INC-0233, titled "Letter bureau duplicate week". The incident began on 2025-03-03 and ended on 2025-03-10. During this period, the letter bureau experienced a dispatch processing issue. The incident period is recorded from 2025-03-03 to 2025-03-10.

## Cause

The cause was Retry loop after a queue failure. Following the queue failure, the retry process did not operate as intended. This resulted in repeated processing of dispatches and contributed to the loss of some letters.

## Effect

Each dispatch written twice; some letters lost. Dispatches affected by the retry loop were written twice, while some letters were not retained. The incident therefore affected both the duplication and completion of letter processing. The recorded effect is Each dispatch written twice; some letters lost. Further queries should refer to INC-0233 and the title "Letter bureau duplicate week".
